docCenter.subtitle: Fathul Fattah - Academic Research
docCenter.heroTitle: Preserving and Sharing the Mouride Heritage
docCenter.heroIntro: The Fathul Fattah Documentation Center is an initiative of the Touba Museum in partnership with Cheikh Ahmadou Bamba Khadim Rassoul University (CCAK). Our mission is to collect, preserve and make accessible the rich intellectual and spiritual heritage of Mouridism.
docCenter.heroMission: We offer researchers, students and enthusiasts privileged access to rare manuscripts, khassaides, historical works and archival documents relating to Cheikh Ahmadou Bamba and the Mouride brotherhood.
